item.description:
This map is an unofficial Fan made expansion. Symbols & Graphics Copyright © 2004-2015 Days of Wonder, Inc. Produced with permission of Days of Wonder, for non-commercial use only.
This follows the principles of the basic Ticket to Ride game on a special board with special cards and rules. The object of the game is to gain the most points by travelling various routes and outwitting other players. You will need the train pieces and the train cards from either the US or Europe base games (or you can buy them from the Days of Wonder shop. You can use stations if you wish.
There is an extra set of cards for the "cities", each with a value to be earned by visiting that "city". These cards are dealt/picked up alongwith tickets in the same quantity and with the same 'keep/dispose' rules. Some of the cards give you extra facilities to complete your tickets. There are also up to 9 bonuses for the end-of-game scoring.
The board does not have any grey tracks or parallel tracks, though there are limited selective options for these.
The main new rule is the option to discard 5 cards and pick up 5 new ones, as your turn. This is very useful if you are desperate for engines or a particular colour card. You can also call time when your wagon stock reaches 3, if you want, giving you the advantage of stopping other players completing tickets.

name.value: Caribbean (fan expansion for Ticket to Ride: Rails and Sails)

item.description:
This is a fan made expansion for the game Ticket to Ride: Rails and Sails. The subject matter for the expansion is the Caribbean Sea and Gulf of Mexico.
This expansion follows the basic rules of the game, but adds several features that address many of the criticisms of the original game. Included is a document that describes the original rules as well as the rules of this expansion.
The additional features for the expansion include "non-traditional" routes that allow players to travel greater distances which simultaneously keeps more train and ship cards in circulation. The expansion rules also tweak the number of cards and vehicles you begin the game with. The expansion rules present an option for trading cards and drawing 2 wild card to further keep boat and train cards in circulation.
The expansion rules streamline the harbor process that better keeps harbor cards in circulation.
Finally the expansion rules streamline the scoring process.
Includes a map to be printed, train and ship cards that can be printed and used (though players may use the train and ship cards that come with the original game if they choose,) 120 ticket cards to be printed, and the rules pdf.

item.description:
It's 1962, and the Steam Era is over. The monorail is the future, and that future is starting in Seattle, Washington. There’s a reward to find the best routes in the city to build the template for tomorrow. Will you go it alone or team up for a chance at victory? The choice is yours...
Ticket to Ride™: The Emerald City is a fan-made expansion to the Days of Wonder, Inc. Ticket to Ride™ series created by Alan R. Moon. A tribute both to Ticket to Ride™ and the Pacific Northwest, this expansion introduces new rules and is designed for players who are already well familiar with Ticket to Ride™’s standard gameplay and mechanics.
Ticket to Ride™: The Emerald City is also the first expansion map to be designed from the ground up to be played either individually (for up to 4 players) OR in teams (for up to 6 players).
Published by permission for non-commercial use. All rights to the Ticket to Ride™ name, gameplay, mechanics, and imagery are reserved by Days of Wonder, Inc., who have not endorsed or playtested this expansion. Everything else © Rainshine Graphics, 2013.
